feature_design.status: Frozen candidate definitions for review; extractor implementation/hash must be frozen before prospective collection

added.name: delta_row_boundary_ink_cost
added.definition: Candidate minus native normalized foreground intersected by fitted row cuts

added.name: delta_column_boundary_ink_cost
added.definition: Candidate minus native normalized foreground intersected by fitted column cuts outside spanning cells

added.name: delta_empty_cell_ink_conflict
added.definition: Candidate minus native mean disagreement between parsed empty-cell flag and independently localized foreground occupancy

added.name: delta_cell_content_mass_error
added.definition: Candidate minus native L1 distance between normalized cell character counts and assigned foreground-component area; weak content-mass proxy, not recognized text verification

added.name: delta_span_boundary_conflict
added.definition: Candidate minus native fraction of independent components cut by a cell boundary, accounting for row/column spans

added.name: minimum_localization_support
added.definition: Minimum, across the two structures, of fraction of native foreground assigned unambiguously to valid cells

forbidden_inputs: Old validation/test or current confirmation outcomes
feature_design.missing_behavior: Any failed/ambiguous required localization, parser failure, or CPU timeout retains native; preserve disposition and training row

geometry_extractor_proposal.image_source: Captured default-native table crop only; no rerender/original RGB/extra OCR
geometry_extractor_proposal.foreground: Per-image Otsu threshold on native grayscale; ties choose smallest threshold; deterministic connected components
geometry_extractor_proposal.components: 8-connected components; minimum area3pixels; rules wider than80% crop width or taller than80% crop height are excluded from text components and separately retained as line evidence
geometry_extractor_proposal.fit: Fit ordered row/column cuts for each parsed logical grid using the same dynamic-program objective: normalized cut-ink cost plus normalized character-mass discrepancy; equal unit weights; lexicographically smaller cut positions break ties
geometry_extractor_proposal.candidate_cuts: Native component edge midpoints plus image edges, bounded to512 positions per axis by uniform deterministic index subsampling
geometry_extractor_proposal.spans: Honor parsed occupied grid; a spanning cell removes internal cuts for its support cost
geometry_extractor_proposal.confidence: Require at least90% foreground area assigned without cutting a component and a unique optimum separated by>1e-6; otherwise unknown/fallback
geometry_extractor_proposal.limits: 20CPU seconds/region;32MiB foreground array cap;max400rows/1000logicalcolumns as parser; infeasible grid is explicit fallback
geometry_extractor_proposal.not_claimed: Component area is not word recognition or character identity; true lexical image grounding remains unavailable without separately scoped localization/OCR

feasibility_before_acquisition.annotation_check: Verify fifth bbox-value semantics and reference-to-native coordinate transform before using first4 coordinates as cell annotation targets
minimum_geometric_checks: At least90% eligible annotated nonempty cell boxes map within native crop and image bounds
At least90% of TRAIN regions have a complete unambiguous coordinate transform; failures remain in evaluation
Median matched-cell IoU>=.5 and assigned foreground recall>=.9 on independently mapped TRAIN annotations
Native image substitutions/occlusion alter spatial features when support changes; scalar-only features remain unchanged
CPU p95<=1second and hard timeout20seconds;no extraOCR
feasibility_before_acquisition.stop: If geometric validity or deployable localization fails, report unsupported route; do not spend acquisition budget or call global density image grounding
feasibility_before_acquisition.limits: Training-only feasibility is exploratory, not generalization evidence; any extractor revision must precede new split/quality freeze

sample_design.sampling: Freeze independent source-ID hash order with seed0 before reading quality; stratify round-robin over pinned source shards; one table selected by filename hash per document
